verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party Agent tracing docs describe automatic instrumentation of supported AI libraries. An LLM Calls view shows individual model requests with prompts, token usage, cost and response performance, and a chat-like view replays every message. The `include_prompts` toggle shows that AI prompt content is captured by default. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-call output and latency fields (latency is only implied by 'response performance'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: **LLM Calls** shows individual model requests. Use it to compare models, prompts, token usage, cost, and response performance
See every message and tool call in a chat-like view.
Supported AI libraries are instrumented automatically when their packages are installed.
To keep other PII on but turn AI content off, set `include_prompts=False` on the integration.
**Traces** shows end-to-end agent runs and the application work around them.
